intro.en: Start with the highest-yield keys and add a few each lesson — the characters you can build keep growing.
intro.zh: 由最有用嘅掣學起，逐課加幾個，砌到嘅字越嚟越多。

body.en: Cangjie reduces every character to 24 base shapes, one per key. We won't rote-memorise — we start with the most useful, highest-yield keys, add a few each lesson, and immediately use them to build real words.
body.zh: 倉頡將所有中文字拆做 24 個基本字形，一個字形住一個掣。我哋唔會死記——會由最有用、砌到最多字嘅掣學起，一課加幾個，即刻用嚟砌真字。

headline.en: Every character is built from these 24 shapes
headline.zh: 每個字都係由呢 24 個字形砌出嚟

body.en: Traditionally the 25 radical keys sort into five families: 哲理 Philosophical A–G (日月金木水火土), 筆畫 Strokes H–N (竹戈十大中一弓), 人身 Body O–R (人心手口), 字形 Shapes S–Y (尸廿山女田卜), and the special X (難). This is the map, not the route — the course deliberately teaches keys in building-block order so you're typing real words from day one.
body.zh: 傳統上，廿五個字根掣分成五個家族：哲理類 A–G（日月金木水火土）、筆畫類 H–N（竹戈十大中一弓）、人身類 O–R（人心手口）、字形類 S–Y（尸廿山女田卜），仲有特殊嘅 X（難）。呢個係地圖，唔係路線——課程特登用砌字次序教鍵，等你第一日就打到真字。

intro.en: You've already learned many faces while building — here we consolidate and check.
intro.zh: 你砌字嗰陣已經識咗好多變形——呢度溫返、考吓。

body.en: You've already met many of these while building characters — 氵 is 水, 扌 is 手, 亻 is 人. No rote drilling: here we consolidate the most common ones, then check that they've stuck.
body.zh: 你砌字嗰陣已經見過唔少變形——氵 係水、扌 係手、亻 係人。唔使死背：而家一次過溫返最常見嗰啲，再考吓你認唔認得。

intro.en: Real characters now — two shapes each, typed in writing order.
intro.zh: 真正嘅字喇。每個字拆做兩個字形，跟書寫順序打。

body.en: Break the character into shapes and take them in the order you'd write it: left→right, top→bottom, outside→in. In a left-right character, the left block is the 字首 (head) and the rest is the 字身 (body).
body.zh: 將個字拆做字形，跟你寫字嘅次序取碼：由左到右、由上到下、由外到內。左右結構嘅字，左邊叫「字首」，右邊叫「字身」。

intro.en: Three shapes each — and the body rule appears: first, second, last.
intro.zh: 三個字形。開始見到「字身」點取碼：頭、二、尾。

body.en: A body takes at most three codes: its first, second and last shapes. 信 = 亻 + 言: 亻 is the head; 言's shapes are 卜一一口, so take first (卜), second (一), last (口). Unsplittable \"unitary\" characters with four or fewer shapes just take them all.
body.zh: 字身最多取三碼：第一、第二同最尾嗰個字形。信 = 亻 + 言：亻係字首；言嘅字形係卜一一口，取頭（卜）、二（一）、尾（口）。冇得分開嘅「整體字」四碼以下就全部取晒。

intro.en: The biggest group. The full quota rule: head max two codes, body max three.
intro.zh: 四碼字最多，規則都喺度：字首最多兩碼，字身最多三碼。

body.en: Composite characters: the head takes at most two codes (first + last), the body at most three (first, second, last). 港 = 氵 + 巷. Unitary characters take at most four codes: first, second, third and LAST — extra middle shapes are skipped. 為 works exactly like that.
body.zh: 分體字：字首最多取兩碼（頭、尾），字身最多取三碼（頭、二、尾）。港 = 氵 + 巷。整體字（冇得分嘅）最多四碼：頭、二、三、尾——中間多出嘅字形跳過佢。為 就係咁：只取第一、二、三同最尾。

intro.en: The longest codes: head 2 + body 3 — and sometimes the body splits again.
intro.zh: 最長嘅碼：字首兩碼 + 字身三碼。有時字身仲要再拆。

body.en: A five-code character = head 2 + body 3. 讀 = 言 (卜口) + 賣 (first 士, second 四, and the LAST shape of the whole body — 貝's final 八). When the body itself splits in two, the quota is 2·2·1: 謝 = 言 (卜口) + 身 (first+last) + 寸 (last shape only).
body.zh: 五碼字 = 字首兩碼 + 字身三碼。讀 = 言（卜口）+ 賣（頭士、二四、尾碼取貝最尾嘅八）。如果字身自己再分做兩截，就係 二・二・一：謝 = 言（卜口）+ 身（頭尾）+ 寸（只取最尾）。

headline.zh: 二・三，同埋二・二・一

intro.en: The last stretch: hard characters, then the graduation exam.
intro.zh: 最後一段：難字，然後畢業試。

body.en: Some characters have a middle that genuinely won't decompose — Cangjie gives you the 難 key (X) for exactly that spot. 身, 興, 與, 齊 all lean on X. There aren't many; these you simply memorise.
body.zh: 有啲字中間嗰嚿嘢實在難拆——倉頡畀咗個「難」掣（X）你。身、興、與、齊 呢啲字都用 X 頂住個難位。呢類字唔多，背熟佢就得。

headline.en: When it won't split, reach for X

body.en: Typing isn't just decomposition — it's ten fingers, each owning its own patch of keyboard. Left hand rests on A S D F, right on J K L; each index finger also stretches one key over (F→G, J→H) without the hand moving. Those nine keys are the home row — every finger owns its column and springs straight back after each press. Bonus: eight of those nine keys — A D F G H J K L — happen to be exactly 日木火土竹十大中, radicals you already know well. They were under your fingers the whole time.
body.zh: 打字唔止要識拆碼，仲要識用十隻手指。左手四隻企喺 A S D F，右手四隻企喺 J K L；食指仲要兼顧多一掣（F 隔籬嘅 G、J 隔籬嘅 H），唔使成隻手郁。呢九個位就係「主行」——每隻手指得返自己嗰行字形，打完即刻彈返原位。仲有個彩蛋：主行九個掣入面，A D F G H J K L 呢八個岩岩好對住 日木火土竹十大中——你識咗好耐嘅部件，原來一早就企喺手指底下。

headline.en: Anchor your fingers — stop hunting for keys
headline.zh: 手指企喺原位，唔使睇住個鍵盤
